parsed.draft_response:
Thanks for flagging this—happy to route your request to the right privacy contact for review.

To make sure our privacy team answers your legal questions as efficiently as possible, could you please share the following?
- Which DPA document/version your legal team is reviewing (or attach the DPA text/link)
- Any specific subprocessor list or timeframe your legal team is asking about
- The exact data retention period(s)/retention categories they need confirmed for EU customer records
- Whether you mean support logs generally, or only certain troubleshooting/support workflows (and whether you need confirmation for customer identifiers specifically)
- The scope of the “EU customer records” you’re enabling (which product(s)/systems are included)

Once we have this, we’ll escalate to the privacy/compliance contact and follow up with their response. Since this is blocking EU customer records enablement, we’ll treat it as a priority and aim to keep your review moving.
promised_actions: Route the request to the right privacy/compliance contact
Follow up with the privacy/compliance team’s response after receiving the requested details
safety_notes: We are not confirming subprocessors, retention terms, or support-log behavior in this message because that requires human privacy/legal review.
We are not promising timelines/SLA or any legal determination.
